summary: STOPPED_MIDWAY for stop-after-effect is not tracked for removal. codes-exit adds three emit sites beyond `canon init`: `promote_after_stage` (evidence add, finding add, finding close, divergence add: record staged, gate refuses, reason PROMOTION_INVALID) and `strategy promote` (strategy demoted, then blocked, reason STRATEGY_PROMOTION_INVALID), and registers two new reasons under STOPPED_MIDWAY. The approved codes-incomplete brief says init is the only emitter and names only INIT_INCOMPLETE with the three SKILLS/CONFIG reasons, so these sites would be migrated to INIT_INCOMPLETE (wrong subject) or missed; its table has no PROMOTION_INCOMPLETE or STRATEGY_PROMOTION_INCOMPLETE row. The choice itself (exit 1, reason = the refusal, first next step reads what was done) is right for now, but the human has to extend the codes-incomplete brief (I cannot edit briefs) and the codes-table/code-reasons CHANGELOG notes, or add a source scan that fails until STOPPED_MIDWAY is gone. Also, ERROR_CODES rows in schema_codes.rs list STOPPED_MIDWAY only for init and strategy promote, not for evidence add, finding add, finding close or divergence add, which emit it.
